config.scope: Conditional exact-viologen polymer graphs, initial geometries and declared salt-mass ceilings only. Global charge/spin hypotheses do not establish localization or spin ordering. Charged-polymer numerical, conformer, solvent/ion and resource validation is required before QM admission.
